title: Real-content unclaimed-property owner list schema
description: Extract the publication header and every unclaimed-property owner record from a State Treasurer 'list of names' notice. The list is a dense seven-column newspaper flow grouped under county and city headers; each owner prints a NAME line followed by a locale/address. Return owners in document (column reading) order.

report_title.description: Notice title from the intro page, e.g. 'Notice of Persons Appearing to be Owners of Abandoned Property'.

publication.description: Publication banner repeated atop each list page, e.g. 'March 2024 • Unclaimed Property'.

owners.description: Every owner record in document order.

name.description: Owner name exactly as printed (the flush, non-indented line of the record).

locale.description: The owner's printed locale/address line(s) (the indented continuation), or null if the record prints no address.

source_page.description: One-indexed PDF page where the record is printed.
